task.summary: Major update: 1. After processing the data found in the original columns: VEHICLE-NUMBER, & ENGINE-NUMBER, instead of replacing these 2 columns with processed data, the program retains the original values of these 2 columns, and created 2 columns: VEHICLE-NUMBER-processed, & ENGINE-NUMBER-processed, containing the processed values. These 2 new columns will be placed adjacent to their original columns for ease of manual verification by the user later on. 2 columns: VEHICLE-NUMBER-processed, & ENGINE-NUMBER-processed, have the same highlight as the other columns specified in the current code, while VEHICLE-NUMBER, & ENGINE-NUMBER would be highlighted in a different color. 2. After the VEHICLE-NUMBER column, the program will create a column called VIN-STRING-LENGTH, which contains the length of the values found in each cell of this VEHICLE-NUMBER column. 3. After the ENGINE-NUMBER column, the program will create a column called ENGINENO-STRING-LENGTH, which contains the length of the values found in each cell of this ENGINE-NUMBER column. 4. Apart from the first sheet named "Processed" in the output excel file, the program will create a second sheet to contain specific columns following specific order. The 2nd sheet will be called "Clean Data", which will have the following columns with data copied from the first sheet: _ 1st column is named "Lot No", with data copied from the column named "LOT-NUMBER" from the 1st sheet. _ 2nd column is named "Commission No", with data copied from the column named "ORDER-NUMBER" from the 1st sheet. _ 3rd column is named "Body No", with data copied from the column named "PRODUCTION-NUMBER" from the 1st sheet. _ 4th column is named "Chassis No", with data copied from the column named "VEHICLE-NUMBER" from the 1st sheet. _ 5th column is named "Paint Color", with data copied from the column named "PAINT" from the 1st sheet. _ 6th column is named "Upholstery No", with data copied from the column named "INTERIOR" from the 1st sheet. _ 7th column is named "Engine No", with data copied from the column named "ENGINE-NUMBER" from the 1st sheet. _ 8th column is named "option", with data copied from the column named "COMBINED-CODE" from the 1st sheet. 5. Aesthetic configuration of the 2nd sheet will be the same as the first sheet: bold header names, enable border, etc. 6. Create column VIN-processed-STRING-LENGTH column, which contains the length of the values found in each cell of VEHICLE-NUMBER-processed column. Place the VIN-processed-STRING-LENGTH column next to the VEHICLE-NUMBER-processed column (on the right side of VEHICLE-NUMBER-processed column). 7. Create column ENGINENO-processed-STRING-LENGTH column, which contains the length of the values found in each cell of ENGINE-NUMBER-processed column. Place the ENGINENO-processed-STRING-LENGTH column next to the ENGINE-NUMBER-processed column (on the right side of ENGINE-NUMBER-processed column). 8. Recolor the 2 columns: VIN-STRING-LENGTH & ENGINENO-STRING-LENGTH to match the color of the 2 columns: VEHICLE-NUMBER & ENGINE-NUMBER 9. Recolor of the 4 columns VIN-STRING-LENGTH, ENGINENO-STRING-LENGTH, VEHICLE-NUMBER and ENGINE-NUMBER
